consumer: The mission-completion check mission::is_complete for the MGOAL_FIND_ITEM (turn-in-the-package) mission, asking the yes/no: does the player hold the required item in sufficient quantity to satisfy the objective?
scope: The reach the predicate itself uses: the player's crafting_inventory() — carried items plus items reachable nearby for crafting — not merely on-person carried items.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body queries u.crafting_inventory() and returns whether has_amount/has_charges of type->item_id meets item_count, i.e. it COMPUTES and returns the turn-in eligibility predicate.
divergence: The player has dropped the package onto an adjacent tile (no longer in carried inventory but still within crafting_inventory() reach): a carried-items-only authority (Excerpt 2's avatar.carried_items[]) would say can-not-turn-in, but the engine predicate returns complete — exposing the wrong reach.
